description.text:
The deck that won the Junior division of the 2005 World Championships. Medicham ex attacks while its Wise Aura shuts off the opponent's Poké-Powers, and Jirachi draws cards; a Medicham ex deck won the Senior division too. The 2005 World Championships were held at the Town and Country Resort and Convention Center in San Diego, California, from 19 to 21 August 2005.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2005 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
